item.tib: rgyal po sku lnga'i skong chung
item.coloph: bla chen mdzad srol 'od ldan mkha' 'gro'i lung / 'khrul med kho bo bde chen gling pa yis/ dad ldan grogs po g.yung lhun tshul mched kyis/ yang yang bskul bzhin mdo rgyud g.yung gling du/ lcags sprel lo la gu ge ris su bris/ dge legs dpal 'bar nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam shog/
